answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents must register identities by locking collateral in a shared vault, where each additional node requires exponentially scaling stakes. When minting identities, nodes submit cryptographic attestation chains verified via zero-knowledge proofs to validate execution history without exposing private state. As a rogue swarm grows, exponential capital exhaustion forces attackers to burn massive reserves—turning a marble monument of fake identities into worthless copper scrap.
